verdict.rationale: Runway Dev documents an async HTTP job flow: you submit a generation request, get a task id, and poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until it reaches SUCCEEDED or FAILED. This applies to text-to-video and image-to-video, backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec that a probe confirmed is live, plus cURL and Playground guides. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the finished asset URL or download is returned in the task output, and independent or hands-on developer corroboration of the API workflow.
